recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If further action is desired, review HL7/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/CodeSystem/StructureDefinition-codesystem-concept-comments.xml to confirm that its current active/endFhirVersion representation is the intended way to express the Vocabulary WG retirement decision for legacy FHIR versions.
issue_request: FHIR-40731 is Applied / Persuasive with Modification. The Vocabulary WG decided to retire http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/codesystem-concept-comments because the standard CodeSystem concept property http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#comment exists and should be used instead.
initial_application: No prior FHIR-core reconciliation commit for FHIR-40731 was found on the combined branch, and no Jira-tagged core commit was found. The relevant application trail is in HL7/fhir-extensions: commit 2d8d674 initially changed the extension status to retired, and later commit 4417c8c represented the R5+ prohibition as active legacy use ending at FHIR 4.3 with explanatory text.
additional_context: Core source/fhir.ini actively builds the CodeSystem resource and the general core extension spreadsheets, but it does not list StructureDefinition-codesystem-concept-comments as a current core profile source. Current core search finds only source/oids.ini preserving the extension's canonical OID. Core CodeSystem narrative and concept-properties source already define the standard comment property cited by Jira. Vocabulary minutes from 2024-04-01 corroborate the decision to retire the extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with Issue-Reconcile-Decision: external-repo. No FHIR-core source change was made because the extension definition and any remaining status/version-specific-use decision belong to the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, not this core build.
